descriptions.zh:
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询DNA作业列表](~~479279~~)主动查询任务状态。

- 本接口目前支持使用的地域为华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海）。

- 提交文本DNA作业目前仅支持华东2（上海）地域使用。
descriptions.en:
- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the system returns a job ID and queues the job for asynchronous execution in the background. You receive the final result in a [callback notification](~~3027141~~). You can also call the [ListDNAJobs](~~479279~~) operation to query the job status.

- This operation is available in the following regions: China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shanghai).

- Text-based DNA jobs are currently supported only in the China (Shanghai) region.
